title: Shrimp Currywurst
description: A German twist on the classic Currywurst, featuring succulent shrimp and a flavorful curry ketchup.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side.
In a small bowl, mix together the curry ketchup and paprika.
Brush the curry ketchup mixture onto the shrimp.
Slice the bread rolls in half and toast until lightly browned.
Assemble the Currywurst by placing a cooked shrimp on each bread roll half.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
